name: SOUL.md
summary: SOUL.md is a Markdown file that defines an agent's personality, tone and boundaries, kept separate from project instructions in AGENTS.md. OpenClaw loads it from the agent workspace every session; Hermes Agent loads it only from HERMES_HOME so the persona does not change between projects.
facts: Built-in default identity if empty or unreadable
Stable voice, but a writable file that steers every turn
how: Write persona, tone and boundaries in SOUL.md
The harness injects it into the system prompt at session start
Keep project rules in AGENTS.md, not SOUL.md
Edit the file to change voice; restart or reload to apply
goodFor: Consistent voice across sessions and channels
watchOut: A tampered SOUL.md hijacks every session
